pairs.registryProposal: Line-number citations in prose ("line 91–92") are a claim class that goes false on any edit above the cited line, even when every symbol name still resolves. doc-rot-detection or source-doc-mapping could tell authors to cite symbols, not line numbers, or have the rot scan check that a cited line number still holds the named symbol.
